name: @starci/common
description: The concepts every StarCi app and package share, with no runtime dependency: the coded error base DomainError (code, params, cause) with its guard and the closed ErrorKind set.
author: starci183

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', {recursive: true, force: true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); for (const f of fs.readdirSync('dist', {recursive: true}).filter((n) => n.endsWith('.d.ts'))) fs.writeFileSync('dist/' + f, fs.readFileSync('dist/' + f, 'utf8').replace(/((?:from |import\()['\x22]\.\.?\/[^'\x22]+)\.ts(['\x22])/g, (all, head, quote) => head + '.js' + quote))"
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && node --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include="src/**/*.ts" --test-coverage-exclude="src/**/*.spec.ts" --test-coverage-lines=100 --test-coverage-branches=100 --test-coverage-functions=100 "src/**/*.spec.ts"
